goal: Measure exactly how many source site×species positive records first appear AFTER a source-recorded first-visit nondetection and distinguish within-date omitted survey methods from later-date new recorded positives. Do not infer validated absence, occupancy change or field temporal closure.

original_source.study: Wenner et al. 2025; Global Ecology and Conservation 62 e03837; Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.15044115, CC BY 4.0

cohorts.published_q1: Original Q1 27 sites excluding kis-banyato and vadasz-turjan; 351 original rows, 117 distinct site×dates, 144 site×species source positives (243 possible slots)
cohorts.published_q2: Original Q2 13 sites where ci==intervention; 188 original rows, 64 distinct site×dates, 77 source positives (117 possible slots); subset of Q1

chronological_rule.first_visit: Each site's earliest ISO recorded calendar date from original source, irrespective of method; first-date positive means any count>0 on that same date by included method.
chronological_rule.later_visit: One or more STRICTLY LATER recorded dates at SAME site; records aggregated by Boolean OR, not independent trap detection; no 20-occasion source resampling or source-row selection.
chronological_rule.full_positive_source: any recorded original count >0 for a species at a site across all site dates and all four method rows
chronological_rule.AV_recorded_method_pair: one acoustic and one visual CSV record on every original site×date; presence of row not equal effort, p(detection), deployment or closure
first_AV_negative_decomposition: av_detected_first: first date acoustic or visual positive
same_day_extra_method_only: first-date AV negative but first-date dipnet or bottletrap source-positive (full positive)
later_AV_first_discovery: first-date full four-methods negative and at least one later actual date AV positive
later_additional_only_discovery: first-date full negative, later full positive, no later AV positive
never_source_positive: original full site×species all dates zero/no recorded positives (UNKNOWN true status)
chronological_rule.horizon_time_basis: days after earliest recorded site date inclusive; count first full-nonpositive site×species with later full evidence first observed within horizon. These are observations, not temporal incidence or closure tests.

fixed_metrics: For Q1 and Q2, all sites × all 9 species: first-visit AV/full source-positive pair counts, ever-positive full/AV counts, first-full-nonpositive later-full-positive counts, first-AV-nonpositive later-AV-positive counts, and 5 disjoint decomposition categories.

Per taxon, date horizon, and wetland category, counts of later source-positive discoveries after first full nonpositive, and duration in days to earliest full and AV witness; preserve exact source dates in an auditable CSV.
Compare same site/taxon first-AV negative but first full positive versus first full negative then later full positive, without calling either a true field false negative.

Summarize proposed 2 source site×2 target species statuses (all full dates; explicit no source positives) and, on those sites, any non-target taxa which have first-date nonpositive later-source-positive evidence.
Prove exact source restoration Q1 full positive 144, Q2 full positive 77 and AV positive 104/61; zero source-invented positives; Q2 positive pairs and exact source site roster nested in Q1.

Positive witness recovery by day horizon is nondecreasing; long horizon 91 includes all later source witnesses; source first-day evidence + delayed first-full-nonpositive evidence + same-day method-only evidence exactly partitions full native site×taxon positives.
Save source-anchored JSON plus site×taxon CSV, site×species×horizon CSV, targeted-source-site CSV, with exact SHA256 and CI tests.
inference_limits: Post-exposure retrospective split within a previously explored public dataset: not independent prospective out-of-sample validation or a new frozen EOG-WF endpoint.

A later recorded positive after first recorded zero proves only that first-date source non-detection did not capture the later positive; it does NOT prove an organism was truly present on the first day, because temporal colonization, phenology, emergence and changing detectability are unseparated.
First-date recorded absence of method row is not proof of that method not deployed. Repeated full zero does not certify ecological absence.
Native method rows are groups not authenticated physical traps, no equal effort or visit independence; duration between first and last can be 91 days and biological closure is unverified.

Never label source zeros as verified true negative or calculate occupancy, p-values, causal restoration effects, actual EOG transition-world counts, A/B/M mechanisms, or fourth EOG-WF predictive score.
